idea-plugin.name: Odoo Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Manage multiple Odoo source projects and independent local runners from one resizable PyCharm popup.

  • Choose a Python virtual environment or create one, then install project requirements or named packages.
  • Configure odoo.conf and launch/test options visually, choose addons and modules, and allocate separate runner ports.
  • Start, stop and restart runners; inspect logs, warnings and errors; open an interactive Odoo Shell.
  • Browse PostgreSQL tables, technical names and storage; search records and explicitly save supported record edits.
  • View CPU and memory graphs for the selected runner and activity for its selected database.

This release targets PyCharm 2023.2 (build 232) with the bundled Terminal plugin enabled. An existing Odoo checkout, compatible Python environment and PostgreSQL installation are required. Shell and RSS monitoring are intended for macOS/Linux. Database features require psycopg2 in the selected environment.

Database edits are direct SQL and bypass Odoo ORM validation and computed fields. Independent project by Oewer Solutions; not affiliated with or endorsed by Odoo S.A. or JetBrains.

Licensed under MIT. Support: oewersolutions@gmail.com.
